activity_check.database_comment_summary: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (63.64%) to PST11 F: 36%, S: 18%, R: 36%. Chemical modification: C-terminal amidation. Activity: active against E.coli 25922 or UB1005 (MIC 128 uM), S.aureus 29213 or 25923 (MIC 128 uM or >), L.rhamnosus 1.0385 or 1.0911 (MIC >128 uM), L.plantarum 7469 (MIC >128 uM), S.thermophilus YM-C (MIC >128 uM) 6 strains C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086 (MIC 2-4 uM), C. tropicalis cgmcc 2.1975 (MIC 2 uM), and C. parapsilosis cgmcc 2.3989 (MIC 2 uM). Antimicrobial robustness: physiological salts: NaCl-sensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086, KCl-insensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086, MgCl2-insensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086, NH4Cl-insensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086, ZnCl2-insensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086, FeCl3-insensitive:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086. MOA:fungi:C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086: depolarized membranes. Structure: beta-sheet structure in SDS or 50% TFE. Resistance development:no:fungi: C. albicans cgmcc 2.2086: after 20 multiple passages. In vitro toxicity: human RBC: <5% hemolysis at 128 uM (HC50>128 uM), poorly hemo.lytic; cytotoxicity: Pig kidney cells (TC50>128 uM), HEK 293T cells (TC50>128 uM).
